Question: I am completing my engineering this year and want to go for further education.I am very interested to know about my religion as well as follow..... 1> Is it necessary to go madarsa for islamic science?? 2>I have read "Fazaila Aamaal" and started reading "Bahishti zaiwar". I will be taking tution for Qiraat.Wants to know each and every book which I should study to know every thing a muslim must know?u r a scholar please guide me. 3>Tell me a dua for increasing memory,making good marks,successful momin engineer. 4>what about islamic courses of jamia millia islamia & aligarh muslim university?? MAY ALLAH GIVE HAPPINESS,SUCCESS & POWER TO EVERY MUSLIM.AMEEN! Answer ID: 23088 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 977/D=195/K=1431) You started reading Bahishti Zewar, it is very good. If you read it before any teacher, it is far better. There is a chapter in Bahishti Zewar part 7, page number 25, "A mureed rather very Muslim should pass day and night in this way", read the article under this chapter repeatedly and hold it in your mind and try to pass your life according to it. It is not necessary to attend any Islamic Madrasa for Islamic teachings, rather contact any pious Islamic scholar and read before him the books like Bahishti Zewar, Hayatul Muslimin, Talimuddin, Jazaul Amal etc. We pray for your success. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
